create_training_event: create a TrainingEvent NamedTuple with train, train_and_dev, and dev dataset keys for a learner
create_prediction_event: create a PredictionEvent NamedTuple with a dataset key for running predictions on unseen data
implement_stream_protocol: implement the Stream Protocol with get_dataset_by_key and events methods for a custom stream
filter_stream_events: use FilteredStream to wrap a stream and skip events with unsupported task kinds
extract_all_dataset_keys: call all_dataset_keys on a TrainingEvent or PredictionEvent to get all associated dataset keys
